domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 轨枕下部存在支承脱空或失去正常支承的状态。
usage_overview: 用于描述有砟轨道中轨枕与道砟间存在空隙的支承病害；在车辆—轨道动力相互作用分析中，这种支承状态可表现为轨枕与道砟反复恢复接触和脱离。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: The applicability of various wheel-rail contact models has been discussed, and to reveal the effectiveness of this model in solving engineering problems such as the soil elasticity unevenness and the contact break of “hanging sleepers”, numerical examples have also been presented with referencable conclusions.

To the contact break situation, such as the track disease of “hanging sleepers”, as shown in Fig. 27 , it is regarded that the sleeper-subgrade interaction stiffness is correlated to the sleeper-subgrade relative displacement in the vertical plane, i.e., k sc, z = ψ(v sd), ψ is a function depicting a mathematical relationship between v sd and k sc, z , generally being obtained by experimental studies.
